1 Presales Consultant (m/w/d) Your tasks
 *  Manage the lifecycle of framework agreements and multi-year customer contracts in a technically and legally complex environment.
 * Support pre-sales activities and business development for Mission Critical Networks (MCN) across the DACH region.
 * Prepare, negotiate, and maintain service, maintenance, and long-term support agreements (e.g., MCO, MCS, LTS) and develop Cyber PACS offerings.
 * Prepare and cost commercial proposals for 5G, RAN, MCx, BSS, and NSS solutions, including upgrades, spare parts, price revisions, and training.
 * Develop tailored technical solutions for Mission Critical Networks in the transportation sector while considering technical, commercial, and financial requirements.
 * Perform commercial and financial analyses of proposals and assess Kontron Transportation's contractual commitments.
 * Present technical and commercial solutions to customers and act as the key interface for communication with internal and external stakeholders.
 * Provide technical support during customer negotiations in close collaboration with the Sales team and take ownership of the customer solutions portfolio covering products and services.
 * Ensure compliance with internal approval and governance processes for commercial proposals.

Your qualifications:
 * Degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a comparable technical discipline.
 * Experience in pre-sales, business development, sales engineering, project management, or delivery within the telecommunications industry, including customer-facing responsibilities.
 * Proven experience managing framework agreements and multi-year contracts in technically and commercially complex environments.
 * Strong expertise in Mission Critical Networks, including GSM-R, FRMCS, 4G/5G, MCx, IP technologies, and professional mobile communication solutions.
 * Solid understanding of deployment, operation, and maintenance services for railway and mission-critical communication networks.
 * Experience preparing and delivering complex telecom proposals or large-scale customer projects, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical experts as well as executive stakeholders (CxO level).
 * Good knowledge of the transportation telecommunications ecosystem, including radio access networks, terminals, transmission technologies, and railway services.
 * Fluent in English; additional language skills such as German or Slavic languages are considered an advantage.
 * Strong analytical, organizational, and presentation skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into customer-oriented solutions.
 * Self-driven, collaborative, and proactive team player with a passion for innovation and excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

Our offer
Community and Success - these are the values that define the way we work together. Become part of our motivated, international team:

 * Open communication and a culture of informal collaboration across all international locations
 * Flexible working hours and home-office options
 * An environment that welcomes new ideas and encourages initiative
 * Individual training and development opportunities based on regular employee discussions
 * A modern office at the Vienna Technology Hub, surrounded by numerous restaurants and excellent infrastructure
 * Regular company events and team activities
 * A wide range of attractive benefits (e.g. meal vouchers, corporate health promotion, company bike program, additional days off for volunteering activities and birthdays, commuting allowance)

We offer a market-competitive gross annual salary starting from EUR 76,000 per year. An overpayment depending on the candidate's actual qualifications and professional experience is intended.

jobs.description:
Mit A1 für morgen. Make it happen.

Was wir tun, tun wir mit Leidenschaft. Darum stellen wir Kund_innen smarte Technologie zur Verfügung, die vieles möglich macht. Wir arbeiten mit Verantwortung - sind dabei aber immer offen, neugierig und kreativ. Denn nur so ist man der Zeit einen Sprung voraus. 

Wir suchen 1 SOC Analyst with German (f/m/d) @ A1 Competence Delivery Center As a Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst, you will play a key role in protecting customer environments against cyber threats. You will monitor security events, investigate incidents, coordinate response activities and support customers in maintaining a strong security posture.

The role combines hands-on cybersecurity operations with incident investigation and customer-focused security support, providing exposure to diverse technologies, threat landscapes and international security environments.

Responsibilities

Security Monitoring & Detection

Monitor customer environments for security threats, suspicious activities and policy violations, ensuring timely identification of potential risks.

Alert Analysis & Triage

Analyze and prioritize security alerts generated by SIEM, EDR/XDR, network, cloud and other security technologies, determining appropriate response actions.

Incident Investigation

Investigate security incidents, assess their severity, impact and business relevance, and distinguish between true positive and false positive events.

Incident Escalation & Response Support

Escalate validated incidents to customer security teams in accordance with established procedures and SLAs, while supporting incident response activities when required.

Customer Communication

Communicate incident details, recommendations and investigation findings to customers in a clear, professional and customer-oriented manner.

Threat Analysis & Correlation

Correlate information from multiple data sources to identify malicious activity, emerging threats and attack patterns across complex environments.

Documentation & Continuous Improvement

Document investigations, findings and response actions within ticketing and case management systems, while contributing to threat hunting, detection improvements and SOC process optimization.

Collaboration & Security Enhancement

Work closely with international colleagues, customers and technology partners to strengthen overall security capabilities and improve customer security posture.

Your Profile

 * Experience in a Security Operations Center (SOC), Managed Security Services, Incident Response or a similar cybersecurity role

 * Good understanding of cybersecurity threats, attack techniques and incident handling processes

 * Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, QRadar or similar technologies

 * Familiarity with EDR/XDR solutions, Microsoft Defender, network security monitoring and cloud security services

 * Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to assess and prioritize security events effectively

 * Experience working in a customer-facing environment and communicating technical findings to various audiences

 * Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple incidents and maintain attention to detail

 * German language proficiency at C1 level or native speaker (mandatory)

 * Strong English communication skills

The minimum annual gross salary under the collective agreement of Telekom Austria AG for this position is EUR 51.042,74 (40-hour full-time work week). Depending on qualifications and professional experience, there is a willingness to offer a higher salary.
